metadata.name: thesis
metadata.description: Thesis: on-chain takes, receipts and scores

docs: Thesis: non-custodial receipts for takes. Users trade from their own wallets; this program
records each take, back and fade in the same transaction, splits the fee, records oracle
prices, settles results into profiles and mints "called it" badges.

buy-in. Only the author's `exit_position` closes a take, and it always creates this
account, so a closed take can't settle on horizon prices instead.

types.name: BadgeKind
docs: The badge catalog. Each badge is earned once per user and minted to them as a
non-transferable Token-2022 token.

fields.name: outputs_mask
docs: Legs whose output accounts this transaction's swaps fill (bit i = leg i), passed as
remaining accounts in leg order. An account the swaps create (an associated token
account) may not exist yet.

types.name: Config
docs: Program-wide settings, one per deployment at `[CONFIG_SEED]`.
Only `init_config` creates a `Config`, and only at that address, so any account Anchor accepts
as `Account<Config>` (owned by this program, with this discriminator) is the config.
Instructions therefore skip re-deriving its address, which saves a hash per instruction.
The same reasoning applies to profiles and positions: each exists only at its PDA, so a check
on its stored `owner` / `take` / `id` fields identifies it.

fields.name: admin
docs: Sets the params and the settler, withdraws platform fees, pauses. Can't touch the trade
allowlist (security review M-2).

fields.name: allowlist_admin
docs: The only key that can change `trade_programs` (security review M-2):
kept apart from the fee admin, so the admin key alone can't let a plain transfer count
as a trade.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed by the admin, takes over once it signs `accept_admin` (two-step, review L-2).

fields.name: pending_allowlist_admin
docs: Proposed by the allowlist admin, takes over once it signs `accept_allowlist_admin`.

fields.name: settler
docs: Signs prices and results for legs with no on-chain price (Gemini markets, trading cards).

fields.name: fee_vault
docs: Program-owned USDC account that collects platform fees, at `[FEE_VAULT_SEED]`.

fields.name: creator_vault
docs: Program-owned USDC account holding creator fees until authors claim them,
at `[CREATOR_VAULT_SEED]`. Kept apart so withdrawing platform fees can't touch them.

fields.name: escrow_vault
docs: Program-owned USDC account holding each position's prediction share (paper-filled Gemini
legs) until it settles, at `[ESCROW_VAULT_SEED]`. Never mixed with fees.

fields.name: trade_programs
docs: Programs a trade may call between `begin_trade` (or `trade_step`) and the receipt: Jupiter,
Jupiter Lend, Compute Budget, Associated Token. Never the Token programs or System, so the
stake can't be spent with a plain transfer (`update_allowlist` refuses them).

fields.name: badge_uri_base
docs: Where badge metadata lives: `{badge_uri_base}{slug}.json` (an `https://` URL ending in
`/`). Set by the admin with `update_config`, so the host can change without an upgrade.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Every tunable number. Changed with `update_config`, never hard-coded.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Platform fee on each back or fade, in bps of the stake (10 = 0.10%).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Part of `fee_bps` credited to the take's author on backs and fades (5 of the 10).

fields.name: min_stake
docs: Smallest stake that counts toward a score, and the author's minimum buy-in, in USDC base units.

fields.name: max_legs
docs: Legs allowed per take, at most `MAX_LEGS`.

fields.name: max_price_delay_secs
docs: How long after a trade (or a horizon end) an oracle price can be published and still be used.
Prices must be at or after that moment, never before.

fields.name: creator_boost_bps
docs: Extra share of a take's platform fees paid to its author, scaled by follower profit. 0 = off.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new takes and positions. Settlement and claims keep working.

fields.name: id
docs: Chosen by the client; with the author, it fixes the take's address.

fields.name: stake
docs: The author's required buy-in, in USDC base units.

fields.name: legs_mask
docs: Legs the author's buy-in actually bought (bit `i` = leg `i`), as on a back: a leg with no
venue yet (or no route right now) is left out, so it never needs a price and the take's
result is the author's real basket.

fields.name: inverted
docs: The take bets against its basket: the author's buy-in is a fade, so every leg must be
fadeable (`Take::inverted`). Appended last, after `legs_mask`.

types.name: EntryPricesRecorded
docs: `source_hash` commits to the market data the settler priced from, so anyone holding that
data can check the price later.

types.name: Exit
docs: A position its owner sold before the horizon. Its sale prices score the owner, and for the
author's buy-in they also set the take's headline result. At `[EXIT_SEED, position]`.
Closed together with its position.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Gets the rent back when the position is settled.

fields.name: price_set
docs: Bit i set = leg i's sale price is recorded.

fields.name: prices
docs: One sale price per leg of the take, 8 decimals, at or after `exited_at`.

types.name: FadeVia
docs: How a fade takes the other side of a leg.

types.name: LegPrice
docs: One leg's price, signed for by the settler.

fields.name: price
docs: 8 decimals. Prediction legs: odds between 0 and `PRICE_ONE` (entry strictly between).

fields.name: published_at
docs: When the source published this price (unix seconds). Must be the first price at or
after the trade (entry), the horizon end (exit) or the sale, within `max_price_delay_secs`.

types.name: LegPrices
docs: A leg's prices for one position, 8 decimals, for the token this owner actually bought.

fields.name: entry
docs: At or after the trade.

fields.name: exit
docs: At or after the horizon end.

types.name: LegSpec
docs: One leg of a basket, as the author chose it. Every leg is priced by the settler, so the
leg names what it tracks but not a price feed: the price source can change off-chain.

fields.name: asset
docs: What the leg tracks: for spot and perp legs the underlying's id (`underlyingId` in
`packages/venues`), so backers can buy any issuer's token for it; for off-chain legs the
sha256 of the venue's market id.

fields.name: leverage
docs: 1 for spot; above 1 only for perps.

fields.name: id
docs: Chosen by the client; with the take and owner, it fixes the position's address.
0 is reserved for the author's buy-in.

fields.name: stake
docs: USDC base units.

fields.name: legs_mask
docs: Bit i set = leg i is included. The Blink includes only spot and yield legs;
a fade includes only fadeable legs.

types.name: PartSale
docs: Part of a position its owner sold before the horizon (`sell_part`): a fraction of what was
left. It scores on its own sale prices (`record_part_prices`), entry to sale, on `stake`, and
settles on its own (`settle_part`, in seq order) while the rest of the position runs on.
At `[PART_SALE_SEED, position, seq u16 LE]`. Closed when it settles; rent to `rent_payer`.

fields.name: bps
docs: The fraction of the position's remaining stake sold, in bps (1 to 9,999).

fields.name: stake
docs: The cost basis sold, USDC base units.

fields.name: escrow_returned
docs: The escrowed prediction and card share returned to the owner at the sale.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Gets the rent back when the part settles.

fields.name: price_set
docs: Bit i set = leg i's sale price is recorded.

fields.name: prices
docs: One sale price per leg of the take, 8 decimals, at or after `sold_at`.

types.name: Position
docs: One back or fade. Temporary: settling it folds the result into the owner's profile,
closes it and refunds the rent to `rent_payer`.
At `[POSITION_SEED, take, owner, id]`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Gets the rent back when the position is settled and closed.

fields.name: stake
docs: USDC base units.

fields.name: legs_mask
docs: Bit i set = leg i is part of this position.

fields.name: prices
docs: One entry per leg of the take (not just the included ones), indexed by leg.

fields.name: entry_set
docs: Bit i set = leg i's entry (exit) price is recorded. A price can legitimately be 0
(a prediction that resolved No), so 0 can't mean "missing".

fields.name: scored
docs: At or above the minimum stake, so it counts toward the owner's score.

fields.name: exited
docs: Sold before the horizon (`exit_position`): it scores on its `Exit` account's prices.

fields.name: escrowed
docs: The stake's prediction share, in USDC base units, held in the escrow vault and returned to
the owner at a sale (`exit_position`, which then sets this to 0) or when the position
settles. Prediction legs are paper-filled at Gemini's prices.

fields.name: remaining
docs: Cost basis still held, in USDC base units: `stake` at open, lowered by each partial sale
(`sell_part`). The final settlement scores on this.

fields.name: parts
docs: Partial sales made so far; the next one's seq (its `PartSale` PDA).

fields.name: parts_settled
docs: Partial sales settled so far. They settle in order (seq = `parts_settled`), and the
position settles only once every one has (`parts_settled == parts`).

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: P&L realized by settled partial sales, in USDC base units (scored or not).

types.name: PositionExited
docs: The owner sold the position before the horizon. It scores on prices at or after `exited_at`.

fields.name: escrow_returned
docs: The escrowed prediction share, returned to the owner at the sale.

fields.name: stake
docs: The cost basis sold: what was left after any partial sales.

fields.name: escrowed
docs: The prediction share held in escrow until the position settles.

types.name: PositionPartSold
docs: The owner sold part of a position before the horizon (`sell_part`). The part scores on its
own sale prices and settles on its own (`PartSettled`); the rest runs on.

fields.name: escrow_returned
docs: The sold fraction of the escrowed prediction and card share, returned to the owner.

fields.name: exited
docs: Scored at its sale rather than at the horizon.

fields.name: escrow_returned
docs: Escrow returned to the owner.

fields.name: stake
docs: The cost basis this settlement scored: what was left after any partial sales.

types.name: Profile
docs: A user's permanent track record: raw stats only. The score formula is computed off-chain.
At `[PROFILE_SEED, owner]`.

fields.name: scored_stake
docs: Sum of scored stakes, in USDC base units.

fields.name: scored_pnl
docs: Sum of scored profit and loss, in USDC base units.

fields.name: takes_settled
docs: The owner's own takes that have settled, and how many cleared each badge threshold.

fields.name: best_take_bps
docs: Best settled take result, in bps.

fields.name: source_hash
docs: Hash of the market data the settler priced from, kept in the event for audits.

types.name: Take
docs: A take: the claim, its basket and its live counters. Never edited or deleted.
At `[TAKE_SEED, author, id]`.

fields.name: claim_hash
docs: sha256 of the claim text. The text itself lives off-chain.

fields.name: horizon_end
docs: When the take settles if the author never sells (a year after posting, by config), and
the last moment anyone can sell a position before it settles on horizon prices instead.

fields.name: open_positions
docs: Positions not yet settled and closed.

fields.name: platform_fees_from_backs
docs: Platform's part of the fees from the side that agrees with this take (backs, or fades of
an inverted take), for the creator boost.

fields.name: result_bps
docs: Headline return in bps: the author's position, entry to its sale (or to the horizon if
the author never sold). Set at settlement.

fields.name: closed_at
docs: When the author sold their buy-in and the take closed; 0 while they haven't. Kept here
because the author's exit account closes once their buy-in settles.

fields.name: inverted
docs: The take bets against its basket ("crypto sucks" over BTC/ETH/SOL perps): its author, and
everyone who agrees, hold `Side::Fade`; `Side::Back` disagrees. Sides stay literal
everywhere else (`backers`, `faders`, positions); `agree_side` says which one agrees.
Every leg of an inverted take can be faded. Appended, after `closed_at`.

types.name: TakeClosed
docs: The author sold their buy-in: the take takes no new backs or fades, and settles on the sale's
prices (`settle_take`). Emitted after `PositionExited`, in the same instruction.

fields.name: inverted
docs: The take bets against its basket: the author's buy-in is a fade (`Take::inverted`).

types.name: TradeProved
docs: Emitted by every receipt (`create_take`, `back`, `fade`) with what its trade's proof measured:
only changes inside the trade's brackets count, so tokens moved in from elsewhere don't.

fields.name: spent
docs: USDC that left the owner's account inside the brackets.

fields.name: outputs_mask
docs: Legs with an output account (bit i = leg i); `outputs` and `received` follow in leg order.

fields.name: received
docs: How much each output account grew inside the brackets, in its token's base units.

fields.name: open
docs: Opens a bracket (first in a later transaction of the trade) or closes one (last in a
transaction that isn't the trade's last).

fields.name: outputs_mask
docs: Legs whose output accounts this bracket watches, as in `begin_trade`. Closing must name
the same legs it opened with.

types.name: TradeTicket
docs: Proof of trade for one position, while its trade runs. At `[TICKET_SEED, position]`.
The trade runs in one or more transactions. Each one is a *bracket*: it opens with
`begin_trade` (the first) or `trade_step` (later ones), and closes with `trade_step` or, in the
last transaction, the receipt (`create_take`, `back`, `fade`). Only programs in the config's
`trade_programs` may run inside a bracket. A bracket measures only what happens inside it, so
USDC moved between the trade's transactions never counts. The receipt requires the owner's
USDC to have dropped by at least the stake across all brackets, and each bought leg's output
account (a token account, or a Phoenix trader account for perp legs and shorts) to have
grown, then closes the ticket.

fields.name: position
docs: The position the receipt will open (its address, derived before it exists).

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the ticket's rent; must be the receipt's payer, who gets it back.

fields.name: owner_usdc
docs: The owner's USDC account the stake is spent from.

fields.name: outputs
docs: Output token account for each leg, by leg index, fixed the first time a bracket names it.

fields.name: spent
docs: USDC spent inside closed brackets so far (net of anything that came back inside them).

fields.name: grown
docs: Bit i set = leg i's output account grew inside a bracket.

fields.name: received
docs: How much each leg's output account grew inside the brackets, in its token's base units
(a Phoenix account's in base lots of its position).
The receipt emits it (`TradeProved`) so the settler values what was really bought.

fields.name: named
docs: Bit i set = leg i's output account has been named (`outputs[i]` is fixed).

fields.name: phoenix
docs: Bit i set = leg i's output is a Phoenix trader account (its "balance" is its position
size), not a token account. Perp legs and Phoenix shorts must be; token legs mustn't.

fields.name: open_ix
docs: The open bracket: the opening instruction's index in its transaction, or `NO_BRACKET`.

fields.name: open_mask
docs: Outputs the open bracket watches (bit i = leg i), and their balances when it opened.

fields.name: new_trade_programs
docs: Replaces the whole trade allowlist when set.

fields.name: new_allowlist_admin
docs: Proposes a new allowlist admin, who takes over by signing `accept_allowlist_admin`.

fields.name: new_admin
docs: Proposes a new admin, who takes over by signing `accept_admin` (a mistyped key can't
lose the role). Proposing again replaces the proposal; propose yourself to cancel it.

fields.name: new_badge_uri_base
docs: Where badge metadata lives from now on (`{base}{slug}.json`). Badges already minted keep theirs.

constants.name: AUTHOR_POSITION_ID
docs: Id of the author's own buy-in position, created with the take.

constants.name: BADGE_SYMBOL
docs: Symbol on every "called it" badge mint.

constants.name: DEFAULT_BADGE_URI_BASE
docs: Badge metadata URIs are `{Config::badge_uri_base}{badge slug}.json`. A new config starts with
this placeholder until the admin sets the real base with `update_config` (
Supabase Storage's public `badges` bucket). Badges already minted keep the URI they were
minted with (the badge mint is its own update authority, so only the program could change it).

constants.name: ESCROW_VAULT_SEED
docs: Holds the prediction share of stakes (Gemini legs are paper-filled) until positions settle.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Hard ceiling on the platform fee, in bps of the stake (1%, ten times the launch fee). The admin
sets the fee in the config but can never go above this, so a fee change can't take more than
1% of a stake, even from a trade already signed (security review M-1).
Raising it takes a program upgrade.

constants.name: MAX_OPEN_PARTS
docs: Most partial sales a position can have waiting to settle at once.

constants.name: PART_SALE_SEED
docs: A partial sale, at `[PART_SALE_SEED, position, seq u16 LE]`.

constants.name: PRICE_DECIMALS
docs: Prices are stored as u64 with 8 decimals (1 USD = 100_000_000).

constants.name: PRICE_ONE
docs: 1.0 in price units. Prediction legs are priced as odds from 0 to `PRICE_ONE`.

constants.name: TICKET_SEED
docs: A trade ticket, at `[TICKET_SEED, position]`: the proof-of-trade record for the position a
trade is about to open.
